title: The fixed quotient scalar tensor and section normalization interfaces
statement: Let Λ and Λ′ be commutative condensed rings, let a : Λ → Λ′ be a unital ring morphism, and use their pulled-back coefficient rings on each small pro-etale site [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Fix the internal/section module equivalences [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], unbounded derived tensor and pullback [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and actual operation comparisons [lem-pd-section-derived-pushpull-normalization, def-sfb-module-object-projection-map]. Record the section ring map induced by a, its sheafified extension-of-scalars cochain model [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and the total scalar balancing map. TensorNormalized is the scalar tensor/counit square on every flat-term K-flat pair. ScalarSectionData consists of an ordinary section extension model, its ordinary comparison and its derived comparison. ScalarSectionNormalized fixes the scalar-unit generator and the computation square on every complex. UnitCondition records invertibility of the localized regular units and the three monoidal constraint equations. SectionTensorNormalized fixes the sheafified balancing generator and its cochain square; TensorSectionCondition is conjugation by the fixed scalar and tensor comparisons. GeometricCondition identifies the specified native pullback tensorator, adjunction unit and counit through the fixed section comparisons. SectionPullNormalized fixes the ordinary scalar/pullback balancing map and its all-complex computation square; PullSectionCondition conjugates the specified scalar/pullback transformation by those same comparisons. All formulas are the exact Lean definitions, with no flatness of a or boundedness assumption.
